title: High Blood Pressure: Normal Range, Indian Data, Home Checks and When It's an Emergency
seoTitle: High Blood Pressure: Range, Symptoms & Free Tests in India
seoDescription: High blood pressure means 140/90 or more on two days. See how Indian, US and European charts differ, how to check BP at home and get free screening.
excerpt: Why US charts call 130/80 hypertension and Indian guidelines don't, how many Indians have high BP, how to measure it at home without errors, how much salt we really eat, and the warning signs that need a hospital now.
